title: neoachmandra boholensis
intro: Neoachmandra boholensis, commonly known as Bohol Venus flytrap, is a carnivorous plant species endemic to the Philippines. This plant is known for its unique ability to capture and digest insects for nutrients. The health benefits of Neoachmandra boholensis include its potential to aid in weight loss, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels due to its high fiber content and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties.
